Safety and decision boundaries

A preparation tool—not a substitute for an appropriate professional or official source.

Urgent help comes first

Call 911 for immediate danger or a medical emergency. Call or text 988 for a mental-health or substance-use crisis. Stop driving a vehicle that may be unsafe.
